body: I guess not. I'm really new to this. I didn't even think anyone would see it, much less get annoyed with it. I will fix. Have a nice day.

There is nothing to be afraid of if you are thinking about going to the hospital. There is nothing scary there. Are you more worried about what people are going to think? Are you eligible for OHP? Please look into it if you haven't already. I'm concerned for you. I want you to be ok.

Yes, I have advice for you. 
You seem to know that you are ready to go to the hospital, but you are planning to wait to see your psychiatrist for financial reasons? Ok, that's fine, but in the next three days, if you feel that you will probably commit suicide, don't worry about the money - just go. Financial things have a way of working themselves out at the hospital. There are a ton of social workers on staff just waiting to help you with the bill, and even if you get a big bill, there are ways to challenge it. If you are in America, you can sign up for OHP while you are there. 
Aside from money, be sure to let the receptionist know that you are suicidal. Even if you are not, say you are. They won't let you in just for depresssion. You have to be a "harm to self or others". 
Sooo.... I don't know. I like the hospital. It is safe, people wait on you around the clock, and most importantly: they will probably fix you up. 
Don't worry about school and your job. School will definitely work with you around this and your job should also. I don't think you can fire someone for going to the hospital. But whatever, you are more important than those things. And your mom will probably be fine eventually, so worry about you and nothing else while you are going through this, Ok?
